mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with prochlorperazine (antipsychotic with dopamine antagonism) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and severe CNS depression through additive effects on monoamine pathways and sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: Avoid combination; if antipsychotic necessary with MAOI therapy, use atypical antipsychotics with lower dopaminergic activity under close monitoring with blood pressure surveillance.
